FTXUI — vendored, static
========================

Tag:     v6.1.9 (latest stable 6.x)
Source:  https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/releases/download/v6.1.9/source.tar.gz
SHA-256: 868670e451c38bdc3ad23d086796543cde4a845fd0420148b198dff5cbe08285  (original tarball)
Files:   include/ftxui/** and src/ftxui/{dom,screen,component}/** (no
         *_test.cpp, no *_fuzzer.cpp, no CMakeLists/BUILD.bazel/scripts/
         examples/docs), LICENSE. The upstream layout is kept as-is: both
         the include/ and the src/ dir are on the -isystem path, because
         the private headers live next to their .cpp.
License: MIT (per LICENSE)

Vendored rather than taken from the distro for two reasons, in this order:
CI-portability and reproducibility. There is no distro package we can rely
on being present in every environment the project is built or gated in, and a
pinned source tree with a pinned SHA-256 is the only way the release tarball
can claim the same sources that were tested.

Compiled per mode with relaxed warnings (`-w`): third-party code must not
gate on our -Werror set (Makefile vendored-C++ rule). Includes go through
-isystem so their headers never trip our warning flags either. The only
sources we compile are dom/, screen/ and component/ — the amalgamated and
example trees are not vendored.

Update by replacing the tree and this manifest in one commit, and re-run
`make musl` (stage 8.2) if the static-link requirements change.
